<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="Pool" name="Company" processRef="Process" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="Lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Purchase</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Submit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Edit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Supervisor" name="Supervisor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Review</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Approved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Treasurer" name="Treasurer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Check</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Order</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Accept</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendBack</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Payment" name="Payment system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Link</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Wait</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start" name="Product or service required" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Purchase" name="Purchase product or service" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Submit" name="Submit expense report with receipts" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Merge" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Review" name="Review expense report" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Approved" name="Report approved?" default="F_Rejected" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Check" name="Check receipts against list of items" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Order" name="All in order?" default="F_NotOrder" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Accept" name="Accept expenses for processing" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendBack" name="Send report back to employee" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Edit" name="Edit expense report" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Link" name="Link to payment system" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_Wait" name="Wait for payment confirmation" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End" name="Payment confirmed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="Start" targetRef="Task_Purchase" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="Task_Purchase" targetRef="Task_Submit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" sourceRef="Task_Submit" targetRef="Gw_Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4" sourceRef="Gw_Merge" targetRef="Task_Review" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5" sourceRef="Task_Review" targetRef="Gw_Approved" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Approved" name="yes" sourceRef="Gw_Approved" targetRef="Task_Check" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Rejected" name="no" sourceRef="Gw_Approved" targetRef="Task_Edit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6" sourceRef="Task_Check" targetRef="Gw_Order" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Order" name="yes" sourceRef="Gw_Order" targetRef="Task_Accept" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_NotOrder" name="no" sourceRef="Gw_Order" targetRef="Task_SendBack" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7" sourceRef="Task_SendBack" targetRef="Task_Edit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F8" sourceRef="Task_Edit" targetRef="Gw_Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F9" sourceRef="Task_Accept" targetRef="Task_Link" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F10" sourceRef="Task_Link" targetRef="Task_Wait" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F11" sourceRef="Task_Wait" targetRef="End" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
